easy.def: A picture of the inside of your body.
examples: The x-ray showed the bones in my hand.
The dentist took an x-ray of my teeth.

more.def: A special picture that shows bones and other parts inside the body.
examples: The doctor looked at the x-ray to see if his arm was broken.
The x-ray showed that the dog had swallowed a coin.
At the airport, bags are checked with an x-ray.

easy.def: A toy or tool for music that you hit with sticks.
examples: I play a song on the xylophone.
The xylophone has bars of many colors.
He hit the xylophone with a stick.

more.def: A musical instrument with a row of bars that you strike with small mallets.
examples: She played a cheerful tune on the xylophone in music class.
The band has a xylophone player.
The xylophone's wooden bars each make a different note.
